image_description: A close-up, cropped view of a green and beige audio cassette tape. The top half is translucent green plastic showing internal spools and reversed text on a label. The bottom half is opaque beige plastic with molded details including holes and slots. The image appears to be AI-generated due to the nonsensical, mirrored text and slight structural irregularities in the plastic molding.
